review.posthog_relevance: Apple Search Ads OAuth token refresh and reconnection behavior
review.reason: The change removes a transient error check and replaces it with a terminal-state check, while adding missing error messages. This could prevent unnecessary reconnection failures during transient network blips while still raising errors when the OAuth grant is confirmed dead. observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Removes unused import of ERROR_TOKEN_REFRESH_FAILED; no longer checks integration.errors for refresh failure.
observations.posthog_connection: Apple Search Ads OAuth token refresh; the removed check would have raised an error on transient network blips, potentially stopping a recoverable sync.

observations.behavior: Replaces check of integration.errors with integration.config.get("refresh_terminal"). Adds comment explaining that refresh_terminal only latches when the grant is confirmed dead, while transient failures still allow the still-valid token to be used.
observations.posthog_connection: Apple Search Ads OAuth token refresh; distinguishes transient refresh failures (keep old token) from terminal failures (raise reconnect error).

observations.behavior: Adds imports of MISSING_TOKEN_MESSAGE and TOKEN_REFRESH_FAILED_MESSAGE to the source module.
observations.posthog_connection: Apple Search Ads source; these messages are used to identify OAuth grant failures that require reconnection rather than retry.
